annotations.title: Put a quote in the cart to order it

description: Puts a saved quote's lines in the cart, as the quote page's Convert to order does, and returns the checkout link. No order is placed: the customer chooses delivery and pays (or orders on account) at checkout on printdash.io. Only the quote's owner can, and every line needs artwork unless Printdash priced it. Needs a signed-in Printdash account: called without one, the connection asks the customer to sign in on printdash.io.

quote.description: The quote number (or the quote id from its link).
